title: Genome-Wide Identification of m(6)A Writers, Erasers and Readers in Poplar 84K.
authors: Sun, Xiaochen; Wu, Wenli; Yang, Yanfang; Wilson, Iain; Shao, Fenjuan; Qiu, Deyou
one_liner_zh: 该文对杨树m6A RNA修饰通路基因进行全基因组鉴定与表达分析，虽含同源建模和分子对接，但核心对象为RNA修饰蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: N(6)-methyladenosine (m(6)A) RNA modification is a conserved mechanism to regulate gene expression that plays vital roles in the development of plants. However, the m(6)A RNA modification in forest trees remains limited. Here, we performed a complete analysis of m(6)A writers, erasers and readers in Poplar 84K, including gene location, gene structures, conserved motifs, phylogenetic relationships, promoter analysis, expression profiles and the homology modeling. We have identified 61 m(6)A pathway genes in Poplar 84K (Populus alba x Populus glandulosa), including 14 m(6)A writers, 14 m(6)A erasers and 33 m(6)A readers. Phylogenetic analysis indicated that the m(6)A writers and erasers were clustered into four groups and m(6)A readers were clustered into two groups. Promoter analysis showed that m(6)A pathway genes were mainly responsive to low oxygen followed by ABA and ethylene. The expression of the identified m(6)A pathway genes showed tissue-specific expression patterns in leaves, xylem, phloem and roots. Moreover, 17 genes were significantly up-regulated and 13 genes were significantly down-regulated in poplar overexpressing the transcription factor LBD15. Homology modeling and molecular docking results suggested that PagFIP37b was most likely to be regulated by LBD15, and the qPCRshowed that PagFIP37b were up-regulated in the LBD15-oe plants. The results provide insights that aid in the future elucidation of the functions of these m(6)A pathway genes and the epigenetic regulation mechanism of these genes in Poplar 84K.
abstract_zh: N(6)-甲基腺苷（m(6)A）RNA修饰是一种保守的基因表达调控机制，在植物发育中发挥重要作用。然而，林木中m(6)A RNA修饰的研究仍较为有限。本研究对84K杨树中的m(6)A写入器（writers）、擦除器（erasers）和读取器（readers）进行了全面分析，包括基因定位、基因结构、保守基序、系统发育关系、启动子分析、表达谱及同源建模。我们在84K杨树（Populus alba x Populus glandulosa）中鉴定出61个m(6)A通路基因，包括14个m(6)A写入器、14个m(6)A擦除器和33个m(6)A读取器。系统发育分析表明，m(6)A写入器和擦除器聚为四组，m(6)A读取器聚为两组。启动子分析显示，m(6)A通路基因主要响应低氧，其次是ABA和乙烯。所鉴定的m(6)A通路基因在叶片、木质部、韧皮部和根部表现出组织特异性表达模式。此外，在过表达转录因子LBD15的杨树中，17个基因显著上调，13个基因显著下调。同源建模和分子对接结果表明，PagFIP37b最可能受LBD15调控，qPCR显示PagFIP37b在LBD15-oe植株中上调。这些结果为未来阐明84K杨树中这些m(6)A通路基因的功能及其表观遗传调控机制提供了见解。
